subject: Invalid input file format for methylInheritance

messages.author: 5d4a48f945a5a764
messages.subject: Invalid input file format for methylInheritance
parts:
Our goal is to use the permutation test from methylInheritance (runObservation and runPermutation methods) between 2 environments with RRBS data.

We used the BAM files from bismark to get methylation calls for individuals using the processBismarkAln method, as [1]. This generated the CpG text files for each individual, as expected.

After that, we used the methRead method to get the methylRawList object, which is the input for the methylInheritance method. The methRead command, as [2], is referencing the CpG files from the previous step. We tried both separating and putting together different generations (we have two). However, the output of the methRead command is not returning a methylRawList object, it is generating a methylRaw object instead. This is causing the error "methylkit data must be a list containing "methyl RawList" entries; each entry must contain all "methylRaw" objects related to one generation" in the methylInheritance method, as [3].

Also, we realised that the methylRaw object has been generated with all positions, instead of the shared ones across all individuals. After checking the manual, we thought we could use unite(), as [4], in methylKit to merge the common positions, however it outputs a methylBase object, which we cannot input in methylInheritance and we don't know how to transform into a methylRawList object.

We appreciate any help.
